notes.elec: Lighting points are the fittings in the model. Table lamps (20) run off sockets. Sockets: one per 3.5 m of wall, minimum two per room.
notes.water: Tank and booster pump in the basement mechanical room, hot water from a cylinder in the boiler room, three risers. All assumed. Pool plant and irrigation are not shown.
notes.drain: Three soil stacks vented above the roof, 160 mm drains to the street, a pumped sump for the basement laundry. All assumed. Grease trap, floor gullies and AC condensate are not shown.
notes.hvac: One ducted split unit per zone, sized at about 1 TR per 16 m2 (rule of thumb, not a heat-load calculation). Fresh air and condensate drains are not shown.

assumption: Assumed and indicative only: rule-of-thumb routes in the ceiling voids. The brochure shows no services. Not coordinated with structure and not an engineering design.
